rows.quote: Genetic variant information for IVDD, sciatica, LBP, and CHD was sourced from the FinnGen consortium (https://www.finngen.fi) with the following accession numbers: finn-b-M13_SCIATICA, which included 9,917 European-descent patients and 134,889 control participants; finn-b-M13_INTERVERTEB, with 6,827 European-descent patients and 134,889 control participants; and finn-b-M13_LOWBACKPAIN, comprising 15,565 European-descent patients and 134,889 control participants (Supplementary Table 1).
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rules B, G, C4): the sentence gives the accessions finn-b-M13_SCIATICA, finn-b-M13_INTERVERTEB and finn-b-M13_LOWBACKPAIN. C4, third case: no dictionary row lists the finn-b prefix, a range holding these accessions, or the accessions themselves (the FinnGen rows list only release names such as finngen_R5), so the accession is absent from the dictionary; the sentence carries no release number and no citation, so C5 gives no code, and the endpoint counts are not a row's N.

Step 4 (rules C, D): biobank name alone for the validation data; no counts, release, accession, citation or defined analysis (reference 34, Graham 2021, is attributed to the lipid meta-analysis, not to this dataset). No accession for this row, so no case of C4.
